detail.zh: 准入包提供 stdio；可写使用还需要准确匹配 Host runtime allowlist，并具备动态 MCP owner。

conflicts.zh: Server name 不能与另一个已配置 MCP instance 冲突。

detail.en: P0 does not download the server package; the Host must already expose an integrity-pinned runtimeRef.
detail.zh: P0 不下载服务器包；Host 必须已经提供 integrity-pinned runtimeRef。

detail.en: Reads and writes only the roots selected during configuration; those roots are not selected by the Agent.
detail.zh: 只读写配置时由用户选择的目录；Agent 不能替用户选择这些目录。

detail.en: Starts a local npm package as a Host process.
detail.zh: 在 Host 上启动本地 npm 包进程。

detail.en: The admitted stdio descriptor declares no credential.
detail.zh: 准入 stdio descriptor 未声明凭据。

detail.en: The dynamic MCP owner applies and verifies the connection in the current Host.
detail.zh: 动态 MCP owner 在当前 Host 中应用并验证连接。

retainedData.en: The center retains connection recovery data; the external runtime remains Host-owned, and file changes inside configured roots are not undone.
retainedData.zh: 扩展中心保留连接恢复数据；外部 runtime 仍由 Host 持有，配置目录内的文件变更不会被撤销。

summary.en: Adds a managed connection to an exact, Host-preprovisioned filesystem MCP runtime for user-selected roots.
summary.zh: 为 Host 预置且版本准确的文件系统 MCP runtime 添加受管连接，并限定到用户选择的目录。

detail.en: The exact preprovisioned runtime and its Tool generation must be observed on the target Host.

detail.zh: 该 Release 声明并测试了准确的 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 Host 与 Web Client 接口。

components.zh: 模型可见只读解析工具

detail.en: The Center downloads the integrity-pinned asset, then real Loader validation runs its in-process code with the Host user's network authority.
detail.zh: 中心下载 integrity-pinned 物料，随后真实 Loader 验证会以 Host 用户网络权限运行其进程内代码。

detail.en: Real Loader validation executes the candidate before commit; that code can read or change files accessible to the Host user.
detail.zh: 真实 Loader 验证会在提交前执行候选代码；该代码可以读取或修改 Host 用户可访问的文件。

detail.en: Validation code can start child processes with the Host user's authority; the validator is not an OS sandbox.
detail.zh: 验证代码可以使用 Host 用户权限启动子进程；验证器不是操作系统沙箱。

detail.en: The validator removes ambient credential environment variables, but candidate code can still reach credential files available to the Host user.
detail.zh: 验证器会移除环境中的凭据变量，但候选代码仍可访问 Host 用户可读取的凭据文件。

detail.en: The admitted behavior GETs one fixed catalog, but in-process Plugin code has the Host user's network authority.
detail.zh: 准入行为只 GET 一个固定目录，但进程内 Plugin 代码具有 Host 用户的网络权限。

detail.en: In-process Plugin code can read or change files accessible to the Host user; DSH does not OS-confine it.
detail.zh: 进程内 Plugin 代码可以读取或修改 Host 用户可访问的文件；DSH 不对它实施操作系统级隔离。

detail.en: In-process Plugin code can start child processes with the Host user's authority.
detail.zh: 进程内 Plugin 代码可以使用 Host 用户权限启动子进程。

detail.en: The resolver declares no credential requirement, but in-process Plugin code can reach credentials available to the Host process.
detail.zh: 解析器声明不需要凭据，但进程内 Plugin 代码可以访问 Host 进程可用的凭据。

detail.en: A bounded safe projection of candidate identifiers can enter model context.
detail.zh: 候选标识的有界安全投影可以进入模型上下文。

detail.en: Profile Bundle membership changes require an external Host restart.
detail.zh: Profile Bundle 成员变更需要外部重启 Host。

retainedData.en: The plugin keeps an in-memory last-good catalog cache and no installation database.
retainedData.zh: 该插件保留内存中的 last-good 目录缓存，不创建安装数据库。

summary.en: Checks current DSH capabilities and ranks candidates from one fixed community catalog without installing them.
summary.zh: 检查当前 DSH 能力，并从一个固定社区目录在本机排序候选；不会执行安装。

detail.en: The admitted SHA-256 matches the immutable GitHub Release asset metadata.
detail.zh: 准入 SHA-256 与不可变 GitHub Release asset 元数据一致。

detail.en: Acquisition and task continuation are not executed by this rc.2 preview.
detail.zh: 这个 rc.2 预览不会执行获取和任务续行。

detail.zh: 该 Release 声明并测试了准确的 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 Host 与 Web Client 接口。

claim.zh: 官方 rc.2 更新路径

detail.en: An official DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 profile updated from public v0.1.0 to v0.1.1, restarted, exposed the Web view and Host RPC, then disabled, restored, and removed the plugin.
detail.zh: 官方 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 Profile 已从公开 v0.1.0 更新到 v0.1.1，重启后观察到 Web 视图与 Host RPC，并完成禁用、恢复和卸载。

claim.zh: 模型可见 Tool 执行

detail.en: The public update acceptance did not independently execute the resolver through a model-facing Tool call.
detail.zh: 公开更新验收没有独立通过模型可见 Tool 调用执行解析器。

detail.en: The pinned artifact is one bounded SKILL.md file with valid discovery metadata and no scripts or assets.
detail.zh: 固定物料是一个有界 SKILL.md，具有有效发现元数据，不含脚本或 assets。

conflicts.en: An existing Skill with the same name and different content must block promotion.
conflicts.zh: 存在同名但内容不同的 Skill 时必须阻止 promotion。

detail.en: Downloads one exact content-addressed SKILL.md after a future confirmed plan.
detail.zh: 未来确认计划后，只下载一个准确且内容寻址的 SKILL.md。

detail.en: Its metadata and instructions enter model context when DSH selects the Skill.
detail.zh: DSH 选择该 Skill 时，其元数据与指令会进入模型上下文。

detail.en: The admitted revision contains no script.
detail.zh: 准入 revision 不包含脚本。

detail.en: A future owner must prove the merged Skill winner before claiming live visibility.
detail.zh: 未来 owner 必须证明 merged Skill winner，才能声称实时可见。

retainedData.en: A future managed install would retain the pinned Skill file until uninstall or purge.
retainedData.zh: 未来的受管安装会保留固定 Skill 文件，直到卸载或清除。

summary.en: A single-file Agent Skill for planning and writing tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation documents.
summary.zh: 用于规划和撰写教程、操作指南、参考与解释型文档的单文件 Agent Skill。

claim.en: Pinned content digest and file set
claim.zh: 固定内容 digest 与文件集

detail.en: Admission observed one file and recorded its SHA-256 at the exact commit.
detail.zh: 准入在准确 commit 观察到一个文件并记录其 SHA-256。

detail.en: The rc.2 preview does not write a Skill root or claim a merged registry winner.
detail.zh: rc.2 预览不写入 Skill root，也不声称 merged registry winner。

detail.en: The pinned artifact is one bounded SKILL.md with valid discovery metadata; its instructions request source-file reads and two read-only git commands.
detail.zh: 固定物料是一个具有有效发现元数据的有界 SKILL.md；其指令要求读取源码文件并执行两个只读 git 命令。

conflicts.en: An existing Skill with the same name and different content must block promotion.
conflicts.zh: 存在同名但内容不同的 Skill 时必须阻止 promotion。

detail.en: Downloads one exact commit-pinned SKILL.md after approval.
detail.zh: 审批后下载一个固定到准确 commit 的 SKILL.md。

detail.en: The Skill metadata and full instructions enter model context when DSH selects it.
detail.zh: DSH 选择该 Skill 时，其元数据与完整指令会进入模型上下文。

detail.en: The instructions require reading source files for evidence; installation does not grant file-write authority, which remains governed by the active Agent tools.
detail.zh: 指令要求读取源码文件作为证据；安装不会授予文件写权限，写入仍由当前 Agent Tool 权限控制。

detail.en: The instructions explicitly call git remote get-url and git rev-parse; actual command execution remains governed by the active Agent tools.
detail.zh: 指令明确调用 git remote get-url 与 git rev-parse；实际命令执行仍由当前 Agent Tool 权限控制。

detail.en: The Center must prove the merged Skill winner before claiming live visibility.
detail.zh: 扩展中心必须证明 merged Skill winner，才能声称实时可见。

retainedData.en: A managed install retains the pinned Skill file until uninstall or purge; generated documentation and repository changes are outside Center rollback.
retainedData.zh: 受管安装会保留固定 Skill 文件直到卸载或清除；生成的文档与仓库变更不在扩展中心回滚范围内。
